newsitem.title: EGYPT: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - April 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - April 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian economic press this week. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- National Cement (Kawmia) 's deficit increased to 22.73 million pounds in the first six months of the fiscal year up to the end of December, against 18.99 million at the end of the same period of the previous year. Nabil Gabri, who is charged with operating the firm, attributed the increase in deficit to a delay in achieving a debt reschedule agreement with creditor banks. The firm made 20.33 million pounds of profits in the last financial year, which ended on June 30.

- Alexandria Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries made net after-tax, unaudited profits of 15.457 million pounds in the first seven months of this fiscal year. This is compared to 14.152 million in the same period of the previous year. The firm forecast net after-tax profits to rise to 22.8 million over the whole year.

- Foreign firms and Egyptian and Arab individuals have bought 20 percent of Egypt Gas, a stake owned by British Gas GAS.L, in a deal worth 210 million pounds ($61 million), EFG/Hermes managing director, Ahmed Haikal, said.
- Heliopolis Housing and Development increased net after-tax profits in the first seven months of this financial year to 57.73 million pounds.

- Upper Egypt Flour Mills ' pre-tax profits rose to 43.85 million pounds in the first eight months of the current financial year up to the end of February, against 28.181 million in the same period of the previous year.

- Cairo Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries made net pre-tax, unaudited profits of 19.976 million pounds in the first seven months of this fiscal year on 14.982 million in the same period of the previous year.

- Central and West Delta Flour Mills sharply increased pre-tax profits to 41.99 million pounds in the first seven months up to the end of January from 28.04 million in the same period of the previous year. The figures have not been audited yet.
- Mohandes Bank made 70 million pounds of gross profits in calenday 1996 against 57.7 million in the previous year, a bank source said.
